text:
marta: Quick sync — ACME pushed back on our new tier transition terms. They want an 'escape window' for first 90 days and flexible burst credits tied to usage. Thoughts?
devon: FYI they signaled deal pending on this. they need ability to scale up for demo week without committing more than 3mo.
ryan: technically we can add a short-lived burst pack with quota tokens. main risk: scheduling on Dedicated pools during peak.
liz: ops: we can gate burst with a soft-cap and auto-fallback to queued requests. but SLA will degrade.
sana: legal: we can draft a 90-day trial escape clause, but need clarity on data retention and contract termination fees.
marta: proposed compromise: 90-day trial escape + capped burst credits (e.g. 500k tokens/month) and one-time pro-rata refund if they churn within 30 days.
devon: customer asked for no refund, just shorter notice period. prefer to avoid refunds from rev ops perspective.
ryan: implementation note: for Dedicated we need per-customer tokens -> add db flag + enforcement at routing layer. low complexity but needs rollout plan.
liz: rollout impact: require telemetry + alerting for token exhaustion. can roll as feature flag for one week canary.
sana: contract language draft suggestion:

```
Customer may terminate during the initial 90-day onboarding period with 10 days' notice. Usage above the included monthly burst allowance will be billed at the agreed overage rate. No refund except for billing errors.
```

marta: ok — action items: (1) legal to finalize wording, (2) eng to scope per-customer token enforcement and canary, (3) ops to add alerting + fallback plan, (4) sales to communicate to ACME with the suggested compromise.
devon: I'll tell ACME we can offer 90-day escape + 500k burst tokens, with soft-cap fallback. they want the offer by EOD Thursday.
ryan: ETA: 2 sprints for full enforcement, but can do feature-flagged canary in 5 days if we drop analytics retention to minimal.
liz: ops will prepare runbook for fallback and SLA note.
sana: I'll circulate contract language in #legal-drafts and drop a redline by tomorrow.
marta: thanks — assigning owners in Asana. I'll follow up in today's sync. :thumbsup:
